10 shots or 1 shot? 🎯
Every trade has a cost: spread, fees, slippage. If each costs 0.1 R, 10 trades a day burns 1 R. One good trade burns 0.1 R. Over a month: −22 R vs −2.2 R.
Example math: 0.1 R cost per trade, 22 trading days. Not a promise of profit.
Wait for your shot. Take it once. Follow @spider.trades
